commands.summary: Editable Python installation passed before WI054 implementation.
Python repository validation passed before closeout metadata was finalized.
205 tests passed in 438.228 seconds; the 2 existing formal-model tests remained skipped.
All Rust workspace crates and the CLI compiled with Cargo output kept outside the checkout.
All workspace tests passed, including 11 mutation tests, 4 repository topology/reference tests, graph/analysis tests, and existing WI053 tests.
The existing Python-driven alternate-implementation runner passed 20/20 legacy cases and 8/8 WI050 admission vectors.

Python and Rust create produced equal normalized repository trees and both validators accepted; Rust typed edit and completed-to-active transition were accepted by both validators, with transition source removal and extra history preservation verified.
Exact expected after-state fixtures passed for typed edit and lifecycle transition; no arbitrary JSON patch surface was introduced.

Planning no-write, expected-absent target stale, consumed work/owner/dashboard input stale, external drift rejection, failure before/after operation rollback, pending-completion post-validation rollback, deterministic planning, and unrelated-file isolation all passed.
No frozen-surface changes were detected and .github/workflows/** remained untouched.

python_baseline.python_changes: none; Python remains the reference implementation and conformance driver

graph.nodes: repository, work items, acceptance criteria, evidence runs, scopes, roles, decisions, policies, contracts, invariants, frozen entries, audit findings
graph.edges: depends_on, reverse_dependency, contains, supported_by, supports_work_item, owned_by, affects, supersedes, constrained_by, allows
graph.analysis: next id, scope validity/overlap, dependency/reverse/cycle effects, evidence gaps, unresolved findings, contracts, frozen impact, provenance, and explicit-scope related work
graph.explanation: findings are facts, constraints, or suggestions and carry source record/path basis

mutation.fields: typed create title/status/date/owner_scope/affected_scopes/depends_on/provenance/acceptance_criteria; typed edit title/owner_scope/affected_scopes/depends_on/provenance/acceptance_criteria with derived updated date; transition id/status
mutation.read_set: sorted content-addressed file/directory facts including expected-absent paths; token includes repository identity and facts, never HEAD/mtime/size
mutation.apply: complete typed operation set, in-memory preimages, deterministic writes/moves, owned dashboard regeneration, Rust post-validation, rollback on any failure, no persistent transaction state
mutation.frozen: protected intersections include source reason and apply fails closed without a caller-controlled approval boolean

parity.python_equivalent: create work item and dashboard projection matched the Python reference tree after line-ending normalization
parity.rust_native: canonical edit and transition before/after fixtures matched exactly; Python and Rust validators accepted resulting states
parity.topology: linked worktree, ignored-directory, deterministic discovery, record-relative reference, and repository identity parity retained from WI053 and passed focused tests

unsupported_nonparity_surfaces: PyO3/native wheels and Python CLI/canonical-core cutover
generic decision mutation, evidence mutation, arbitrary JSON Patch, and arbitrary filesystem writes
general SPEC mutation generation beyond the supported work-item/dashboard inputs
provider-backed AI or opaque similarity authority
persistent repository-local transaction database, daemon, or journal
WI050 admission, guard, enforcement, IPC, platform backend, protected-service, cryptographic approval, and authorization migration
Rust remains an alternate implementation outside the explicitly proven WI054 surfaces
architecture_finding: Decision 0040 is satisfied without amendment. WI052 sequencing remains valid: WI055 may wrap the proven typed core, while WI056 must preserve Python compatibility and the explicit unsupported-surface boundary.
